privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How AutoCore collects, uses, and protects data for users and companies at auto dismantlers and repair shops.

sections.title: 1. General provisions
paragraphs: Victor Mishkin, trading as AutoCore, Tbilisskaya 13, Almaty 050000, Kazakhstan, is the seller and controller for personal data collected through the AutoCore product and website.
This policy describes how personal and operational data is processed in AutoCore, a cloud application for auto dismantlers and repair shops.

By using the AutoCore web app or desktop client, you confirm that you have reviewed this policy. Company admins are responsible for the accuracy of data for the employees they invite into their organization.

sections.title: 2. Who this policy applies to
paragraphs: This policy applies to owners and employees of customer companies, users of demo access, and visitors to the myautocore.com marketing site.
bullets: Company owners and admins
Employees with role-based access (warehouse, shop floor, accounting, etc.)
Trial and paid subscription users

sections.title: 3. What data we process
paragraphs: We only process the data necessary to operate the product, support our users, and comply with legal requirements.
bullets: Account data: email, name, sign-in provider ID (Google, Apple, etc.)
Company data: name, business details, branding settings, plan
Operational data: warehouse, work orders, accounting, documents, VINs, and vehicle records
Activity log: who changed what, and when, within the system
Technical data: IP address, device type, client version, error diagnostics

sections.title: 4. Purposes of processing
paragraphs: Data is used to provide and improve AutoCore, perform our contract with customers, meet legal obligations, and pursue legitimate interests in service security, fraud prevention, support, and product improvement. Consent is used where required, including for non-essential cookies or marketing.
bullets: Sign-up, authentication, and managing employee access
Syncing data across web and desktop
Generating documents, reports, and notifications
Processing payments and managing subscriptions
Technical support and security incident investigation

sections.title: 5. Storage and protection
paragraphs: Data is stored on secure Google Cloud / Firebase infrastructure. Access is restricted by security rules at the company (tenant) level and by employee roles (RBAC).
Data is transferred between client and server over encrypted channels (TLS). Critical operations are additionally checked on the server, not just in the interface.

We retain account and operational data while the account is active and for as long as needed to provide the service, resolve disputes, prevent fraud, and meet legal obligations. When no longer needed, data is deleted or anonymized under our retention and backup procedures.

sections.title: 6. Sharing with third parties
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data. To operate the service we work with vetted processors that act under contract and only to the extent required to deliver the service.
bullets: Google Firebase: authentication, database, hosting
Google Analytics and Google Ads: aggregated website and product usage statistics, and measurement of advertising campaigns including subscription conversions
Paddle: merchant of record for product sales, subscription management, payments, tax compliance, invoicing, and refunds
Stripe and app-store payment providers: legacy or platform-specific subscription processing where applicable
Email and support providers: transactional communications and customer support
Professional advisers and public authorities where required by law or needed to protect rights and safety

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or object to processing. You may withdraw consent where processing relies on consent and complain to the relevant data-protection authority.
Send privacy requests to support@myautocore.com. We may verify your identity before acting on a request. A company admin manages employee access and can deactivate accounts within the organization.
When a company is deleted, operational data is removed in accordance with our internal retention and backup procedures.

sections.title: 8. Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The marketing site and the AutoCore app use Google Analytics 4 and the Google Ads conversion tag to understand how visitors find us and where people get stuck, and to measure advertising campaigns. They set cookies and record events such as page views, sign-up, workspace creation, trial start, and subscription purchase.

We do not send your name, email address, company name, or any content you store in AutoCore to Google Analytics. Events carry only which step occurred and, for a purchase, which billing interval was chosen.
Within the AutoCore app, cookies are also used to maintain your sign-in session; these are technical and cannot be switched off without breaking sign-in.

You can opt out of Google Analytics on any site by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on, or by blocking analytics cookies in your browser. Doing so does not affect your use of AutoCore.

sections.title: 9. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy as product features or legal requirements change. The current version is always available on this page, with the update date noted.

sections.title: 10. Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions or rights requests, email support@myautocore.com with "Privacy" in the subject line, or write to Victor Mishkin, AutoCore, Tbilisskaya 13, Almaty 050000, Kazakhstan.

sections.title: 1. Scope

sections.title: 2. 14-day refund window
paragraphs: You may request a change-of-mind refund within 14 calendar days of the original purchase. This policy does not limit any mandatory consumer rights that apply in your country.
We do not apply an “all sales final” rule. We may ask for information needed to identify the transaction and prevent fraud, but we do not impose unreasonable conditions on eligible requests.

sections.title: 3. How to request a refund
paragraphs: Submit the request through Paddle at https://paddle.net or contact support@myautocore.com with the purchase email and Paddle transaction or receipt number.
Do not send card or bank-account details to AutoCore support.

sections.title: 4. Subscription cancellation
paragraphs: You may cancel a subscription at any time through the billing portal. Unless the checkout or applicable law states otherwise, cancellation stops future renewals and access continues until the end of the paid billing period.
Canceling a subscription does not automatically create a refund. Refund requests are assessed under the 14-day window above and applicable law.
